The Amazon Pay API enables merchants to integrate Amazon Pay for payment processing on their websites and mobile applications. It supports one-time purchases, subscriptions, and recurring payments. The API provides checkout session management, charge operations, and refund capabilities with both production and sandbox environments for testing.
